title: Axe Woves
subtitle: Mandalorian
description: A self-assured warrior who borders on cocky, Axe Woves' confidence is fueled by his marksmanship and his withering opinion of said skill among Stormtroopers. Woves served Bo-Katan Kryze's Clan Kryze for a time but eventually drifted away with many of her supporters to become mercenaries convinced that re-taking Mandalore was a pipe dream. Eventually, Bo-Katan challenged Woves and won back his allegiance before they recaptured Mandalore from the Imperial Remnant.
